windows.declaration: THE n = 4 CORPUS, ENTIRE.  Every grouping of the four sites into two pairs, every saturating one, every strict R = 2 pair, the whole seed fan, every R = 4 concatenation and the whole R = 3 driven window.  No sampling anywhere: the corpus is the complete class.
THE COMPLETE ACTOR LATTICE AT n = 4: all Bell(4) partitions of the four actors, no cap and no sampling.
THE COMPLETE SYMMETRIC GROUP S_4, filtered element by element -- the naming theorem's route A at n = 4 is exhaustive.

THE DECLARED-LINK SWEEP AT n = 4, ENTIRE: L = 1, 2 and 3, that is, every initial segment of the q + 1 = 3 canonical directions.  This is the window that separates the modulus's carrier from sqrt(n) and from the characteristic, both of which are 2 at every point of it.
THE COIN-MODULUS SWEEP AT n = 4: m = 2, 3, 4, 5.  Four declared points of an axis the parent fixed at three without deriving it.
THE RECORD FAMILY, ENTIRE ON ITS DECLARATION: every corpus record vector with one cell raised by t for t = 0..6, deduplicated, and every unordered pair of it compared.

THE n = 16 WINDOW.  Only the parallel-class R-tuples are built: the full saturating census at q = 4 needs the 2,627,625 groupings of 16 sites into four blocks of four and is DECLARED OUT OF SCOPE here.  Every n = 16 row below is a row about this window and says so.
THE n = 16 PERMUTATION WINDOW for the naming theorem's route A: all transpositions and all 3-cycles of the sixteen actors, at every prefix.  S_16 has 20,922,789,888,000 elements and is not filtered.

THE CONSTRUCTOR-FIDELITY LEG AT q = 3.  The substrate counts only -- groupings, saturating groupings, strict triples, flat quadruples, window size.  No n = 9 law is evaluated here and no n = 9 finding is produced here.
